source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שִׁמְר֥וּ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וַעֲשׂ֣וּ צְדָקָ֑ה כִּֽי־קְרוֹבָ֤ה יְשֽׁוּעָתִי֙ לָב֔וֹא וְצִדְקָתִ֖י לְהִגָּלֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: keep justice and do righteousness, for near [is] my salvation to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q Keep justice and do righteousness, \q for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} salvation [is] near to come, \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} righteousness to be revealed.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q Guard justice and practice righteousness, \q for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} salvation is near and ready to come, \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} righteousness is about to be made known.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q Be fair to others and live in righteousness. \q Soon I will come to save you. \q Soon I will show {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} righteousness to everyone.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q {{plural_you:Guarden|Guardad}} el derecho y {{plural_you:practiquen|practicad}} la justicia, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} salvación [está] cerca para llegar, \q y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} justicia para ser revelada.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q {{plural_you:Velen|Velad}} por el derecho y {{plural_you:practiquen|practicad}} la justicia, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} salvación está cerca, a punto de llegar, \q y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} justicia está a punto de darse a conocer.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} justos con los demás y {{plural_you:vivan|vivid}} con rectitud. \q Pronto vendré a {{plural_you:salvarlos|salvaros}}. \q Pronto mostraré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} justicia a todos.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Gardez le droit et pratiquez la justice, \q car {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} salut [est] près de venir, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} justice d’être révélée.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Veillez au droit et pratiquez la justice, \q car {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} salut est proche, il va venir, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} justice va être manifestée.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Soyez justes envers les autres et vivez dans la justice. \q Bientôt je viendrai vous sauver. \q Bientôt je montrerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} justice à tout le monde.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Shikeni hukumu na kutenda haki, \q kwa maana wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} [u] karibu kuja, \q na haki {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kufunuliwa.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Lindeni haki na kutenda yaliyo sawa, \q kwa maana wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} uko karibu, tayari kuja, \q na haki {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} iko karibu kujulikana.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Watendeeni wengine kwa haki na kuishi maisha ya haki. \q Hivi karibuni nitakuja kuwaokoa. \q Hivi karibuni nitaonyesha haki {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kwa kila mtu.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Hãy giữ công lý và làm điều công chính, \q vì sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [đã] gần đến, \q và sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp được bày tỏ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Hãy gìn giữ công lý và thực hành sự công chính, \q vì sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã gần và sắp đến, \q và sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp được tỏ ra.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Hãy đối xử công bằng với người khác và sống theo điều công chính. \q Chẳng bao lâu nữa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đến để giải cứu các ngươi. \q Chẳng bao lâu nữa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bày tỏ điều công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho mọi người thấy.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 정의를 지키고 의를 행하여라. \q 나의 구원이 가까이 와 있고, \q 나의 의가 드러나려 하기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 정의를 지키고 의를 실천하여라. \q 내 구원이 가까이 와서 곧 이를 것이고, \q 내 의가 곧 드러날 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 다른 사람들을 공정하게 대하고 의롭게 살아라. \q 내가 곧 너희를 구원하러 가겠다. \q 내가 곧 모든 사람에게 내 의를 보여 주겠다.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Guardem a justiça e pratiquem a retidão, \q pois a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} salvação [está] perto de chegar, \q e a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} retidão, de ser revelada.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Mantenham a justiça e pratiquem a retidão, \q pois a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} salvação está perto e prestes a chegar, \q e a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} retidão está para ser revelada.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: \q Sejam justos com os outros e vivam com retidão. \q Logo vou vir salvar vocês. \q Logo vou mostrar a todos a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} retidão.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q ፍርድን ጠብቁ፤ ጽድቅንም አድርጉ፤ \q ማዳኔ ሊመጣ ቀርቧልና፤ \q ጽድቄም ሊገለጥ [ቀርቧል]።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q ፍትሕን ጠብቁ፤ ጽድቅንም አድርጉ፤ \q ማዳኔ ቀርቧል፤ ሊመጣም ተዘጋጅቷልና፤ \q ጽድቄም ሊገለጥ ነው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q ለሌሎች ፍትሐዊ ሁኑ፤ በጽድቅም ኑሩ። \q በቅርቡ ላድናችሁ እመጣለሁ። \q በቅርቡ ጽድቄን ለሁሉ አሳያለሁ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: \q न्याय का पालन करो और धार्मिकता के काम करो, \q क्योंकि मेरा उद्धार आने को निकट [है], \q और मेरी धार्मिकता प्रकट होने को।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: \q न्याय की रक्षा करो और धार्मिकता पर चलो, \q क्योंकि मेरा उद्धार निकट है और आने ही वाला है, \q और मेरी धार्मिकता प्रकट होने पर है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: \q दूसरों के साथ न्याय करो और धार्मिकता का जीवन जियो। \q मैं जल्द ही तुम्हें बचाने आऊँगा। \q मैं जल्द ही सबको अपनी धार्मिकता दिखाऊँगा।

ru.L: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q Соблюдайте правосудие и творите праведность, \q ведь {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} спасение близко, чтобы прийти, \q и {{deity_pronoun:моя|Моя}} праведность — чтобы открыться.
ru.B: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q Храните справедливость и поступайте праведно, \q ведь {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} спасение близко и вот-вот придёт, \q и {{deity_pronoun:моя|Моя}} праведность скоро откроется.
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q Будьте справедливы к другим и живите праведно. \q Скоро {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} приду, чтобы спасти вас. \q Скоро {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покажу всем свою праведность.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q 公正を守り、正義を行え。 \q わたしの救いが来るのは近く、 \q わたしの義が現されるのも[近い]からだ。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q 公正を守り、正義を行いなさい。 \q わたしの救いは近く、まもなく来る。 \q わたしの義は、まもなく現される。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q ほかの人々に公平にふるまい、正しく生きなさい。 \q わたしは、まもなくあなたたちを救いに来る。 \q まもなく、わたしの正しさを、すべての人に示す。

uk.L: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: \q Бережіть правосуддя і чиніть праведність, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} спасіння близько, щоб прийти, \q і {{deity_pronoun:моя|Моя}} праведність — щоб обʼявитися.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} говорить так: \q Стережіть правосуддя і чиніть праведність, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} спасіння близько і готове прийти, \q і {{deity_pronoun:моя|Моя}} праведність от-от обʼявиться.
uk.R: Ось що каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: \q Будьте справедливі до інших і живіть у праведності. \q Скоро {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} прийду, щоб спасти вас. \q Скоро {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покажу {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} праведність усім.

decisions.choice: righteousness ... my righteousness: what God asks of his people answers to what he is about to do
decisions.reason: The same word is used first of the people's right conduct and then of God's own righteousness, shown in setting things right for his people. Because God is about to act, his people are to live in a way that fits his coming (46:13; 51:5-6).

decisions.choice: my righteousness: God's saving justice, his faithful act of putting things right
decisions.reason: Set beside "my salvation", the word means God's righteousness at work, rescuing his people and setting wrongs right (45:8; 46:13; 51:5).

decisions.choice: near to come: about to arrive
decisions.reason: The salvation is pictured as already on its way. The book's later chapters return to the same nearness (51:5; 62:11).

decisions.choice: Be fair to others; Soon I will come to save you
decisions.reason: Readable explains "keep justice" as fairness toward others and turns "my salvation is near to come" into a plain statement of what God will do.

decisions.choice: el derecho; la justicia
decisions.reason: The pair *mishpat* and *tsedaqah* is "el derecho y la justicia", so that "justicia" can be the same word for the people's right conduct and God's own righteousness in the next line, as the meaning decision points out.

decisions.choice: "le droit et la justice"
decisions.reason: *Mishpat* and *tsedaqah* together are "le droit et la justice", as the terms note settles for Isaiah.

decisions.choice: "정의" for mishpat and "의" for tsedaqah (L, B); "공정하게 대하고 의롭게 살아라" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms; here Readable keeps "의" because the verse sets the people's righteousness beside God's ("내 의") and the link would be lost with two different words (m1).

decisions.choice: a justiça (mishpat); a retidão, the people's and God's
decisions.reason: The same word is used of what the people do and of what God is about to do (m1), so every level keeps one word for it, "a retidão", the book's word for tsedaqah (1:21), and "a justiça" for mishpat. God speaks to the people as a group, so "vocês".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English capitalised-pronoun setting has nothing to change in Amharic; the pronouns stay as written.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the setting the English offers has nothing to change in Hindi; respect for God comes from the honorific plural.

decisions.choice: धार्मिकता for both the people's and God's righteousness
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew word is used of what God asks and of what God is about to do; Hindi keeps one word (धार्मिकता, the key term) for both so the link stays.

decisions.choice: The two tsedaqah of the verse are kept apart: what the people do, paired with mishpat, is "公正 … 正義" (L, B; ISA-1's social pair), and God's own tsidqati "わたしの義" (L, B), "わたしの正しさ" (R), his saving justice paired with yeshu'ati "わたしの救い" (m2; ISA-6 listed 56:1); the echo between them (m1) is carried by the shared kanji 義.
alternatives: 義を行え (one word for both)
decisions.reason: ISA-1 reserved 義 for God's saving righteousness and 正義 for human justice; 正義 and 義 still let the reader hear one root.

source.text: אַשְׁרֵ֤י אֱנוֹשׁ֙ יַעֲשֶׂה־זֹּ֔את וּבֶן־אָדָ֖ם יַחֲזִ֣יק בָּ֑הּ שֹׁמֵ֤ר שַׁבָּת֙ מֵֽחַלְּל֔וֹ וְשֹׁמֵ֥ר יָד֖וֹ מֵעֲשׂ֥וֹת כָּל־רָֽע׃ס

records.literal_gloss: How blessed [is the] person [who] does this, and [the] son of humankind [who] takes hold on it, [who] keeps [the] sabbath from profaning it, and [who] keeps his hand from doing any evil.

en.L: Blessed [is the] mortal [who] does this, \q and [the] {{gender:human being|son of man}} [who] holds fast to it, \q keeping [the] Sabbath from profaning it, \q and keeping his hand from doing any evil.
en.B: How blessed is the mortal who does this, \q the human being who clings to it, \q who guards the Sabbath and does not make it common, \q and who will not lift a hand to do any evil.
en.R: People who do this and hold on to it will be truly blessed. \q They keep the Sabbath day holy and do not treat it like an ordinary day. \q They do not do anything evil.

es.L: Dichoso el mortal [que] hace esto, \q y {{gender:el ser humano|el hijo de hombre}} [que] se aferra a ello, \q que guarda el sábado para no profanarlo, \q y guarda su mano de hacer mal alguno.
es.B: Dichoso el mortal que hace esto, \q el ser humano que se aferra a ello, \q que guarda el sábado y no lo trata como algo común, \q y que no levanta la mano para hacer ningún mal.
es.R: La gente que hace esto y se mantiene firme en ello será verdaderamente dichosa. \q Guardan el día de sábado como día santo y no lo tratan como un día cualquiera. \q No hacen nada malo.

fr.L: Heureux le mortel [qui] fait cela, \q et {{gender:l’être humain|le fils d’homme}} [qui] s’y attache, \q gardant le sabbat sans le profaner, \q et gardant sa main de faire aucun mal.
fr.B: Heureux le mortel qui agit ainsi, \q l’être humain qui s’y tient fermement, \q qui garde le sabbat sans le traiter comme un jour ordinaire, \q et qui ne lève pas la main pour faire le mal.
fr.R: Les gens qui font cela et qui s’y tiennent seront vraiment heureux. \q Ils respectent le sabbat comme un jour saint et ne le traitent pas comme un jour ordinaire. \q Ils ne font rien de mal.

sw.L: Heri mwanadamu [anayefanya] hili, \q na binadamu [anayeshikamana] nalo, \q anayeishika Sabato asiitie unajisi, \q na kuuzuia mkono wake usitende uovu wowote.
sw.B: Heri kama nini mtu anayefanya hili, \q binadamu anayeshikamana nalo, \q anayeilinda Sabato asiifanye kuwa siku ya kawaida, \q na asiyeinua mkono wake kutenda uovu wowote.
sw.R: Watu wanaofanya hivi na kulishika watabarikiwa kweli. \q Wanaiweka siku ya Sabato kuwa takatifu wala hawaitendei kama siku ya kawaida. \q Hawatendi jambo lolote ovu.

vi.L: Phước cho người [nào] làm điều này, \q và con cái loài người [nào] giữ chặt điều đó, \q giữ ngày Sa-bát, không làm ô uế nó, \q và giữ tay mình không làm điều ác nào.
vi.B: Phước thay cho người làm điều ấy, \q cho con người bám chặt lấy điều ấy, \q giữ ngày Sa-bát, không coi nó như ngày thường, \q và không đưa tay làm bất cứ điều ác nào.
vi.R: Những ai làm điều này và giữ vững điều này sẽ thật được phước. \q Họ giữ ngày Sa-bát thánh khiết và không coi nó như một ngày bình thường. \q Họ không làm điều gì ác.

ko.L: 이것을 행하는 사람, \q 그것을 굳게 붙잡는 {{gender:사람|사람의 아들}}은 복이 있다. \q 안식일을 지켜 더럽히지 않고, \q 그의 손을 지켜 어떤 악도 행하지 않는 [사람은 복이 있다].
ko.B: 이것을 행하는 사람, \q 이것을 굳게 붙드는 사람은 얼마나 복된가! \q 그는 안식일을 지켜 그날을 속되게 하지 않고, \q 손을 들어 어떤 악도 행하지 않는다.
ko.R: 이 일을 하고 그것을 굳게 지키는 사람들은 참으로 복을 받을 것이다. \q 그들은 안식일을 거룩하게 지키고, 그날을 보통 날처럼 여기지 않는다. \q 그들은 어떤 악한 일도 하지 않는다.

pt.L: Bem-aventurado [é o] mortal [que] faz isto, \q e o {{gender:ser humano|filho do homem}} [que] se apega a isso, \q guardando [o] sábado para não o profanar, \q e guardando a sua mão de fazer qualquer mal.
pt.B: Como é feliz o mortal que faz isto, \q o ser humano que se apega a isso, \q que guarda o sábado e não o trata como dia comum, \q e que não levanta a mão para fazer mal algum.
pt.R: Felizes de verdade são as pessoas que fazem isto e se apegam a isso. \q Elas guardam o sábado como dia santo e não o tratam como um dia qualquer. \q Elas não fazem nada de mal.

am.L: ይህን የሚያደርግ ሟች ሰው ምስጉን ነው፤ \q ይህንንም አጥብቆ የሚይዝ የሰው ልጅ [ምስጉን ነው]፤ \q ሰንበትን ከማቃለል የሚጠብቅ፣ \q እጁንም ክፉ ሁሉ ከማድረግ የሚጠብቅ።
am.B: ይህን የሚያደርግ ሟች ሰው፣ \q አጥብቆ የሚይዘውም የሰው ልጅ እንዴት የተባረከ ነው! \q ሰንበትን የሚጠብቅና የማያቃልል፣ \q ማንኛውንም ክፉ ነገር ለማድረግ እጁን የማያነሣ።
am.R: ይህን የሚያደርጉና አጥብቀው የሚይዙ ሰዎች በእውነት የተባረኩ ናቸው። \q የሰንበትን ቀን ይቀድሳሉ፤ እንደ ተራ ቀንም አይቆጥሩትም። \q ምንም ክፉ ነገር አያደርጉም።

hi.L: कितना धन्य है [वह] मनुष्य [जो] यह करता है, \q और [वह] {{gender:मानव|मनुष्य का पुत्र}} [जो] इसे दृढ़ता से थामे रहता है, \q जो सब्त को अपवित्र करने से बचाए रखता है, \q और अपने हाथ को कोई भी बुराई करने से रोके रखता है।
hi.B: कितना धन्य है वह मनुष्य जो ऐसा करता है, \q वह मानव जो इससे लिपटा रहता है, \q जो सब्त की रक्षा करता है और उसे साधारण दिन नहीं बनाता, \q और जो कोई भी बुराई करने के लिए हाथ नहीं उठाता।
hi.R: जो लोग ऐसा करते हैं और इसे थामे रहते हैं, उनका जीवन सचमुच अच्छा है। \q वे सब्त के दिन को पवित्र रखते हैं और उसे साधारण दिन की तरह नहीं मानते। \q वे कोई बुरा काम नहीं करते।

ru.L: Блажен смертный, [который] делает это, \q и {{gender:человек|сын человеческий}}, [который] крепко держится этого, \q соблюдая субботу, чтобы не осквернить её, \q и удерживая свою руку от всякого зла.
ru.B: Как блажен смертный, который делает это, \q человек, который держится этого, \q который хранит субботу и не делает её обычным днём \q и не поднимет руки, чтобы сделать зло.
ru.R: Люди, которые делают это и твёрдо держатся этого, будут по-настоящему счастливы. \q Они хранят субботу святой и не обращаются с ней как с обычным днём. \q Они не делают ничего злого.

ja.L: 幸いだ、これを行う人、 \q これを堅く守る人間は。 \q 安息日を守ってこれを汚さず、 \q 自分の手を守って、どんな悪も行わない。
ja.B: なんと幸いなことか、これを行う人、 \q これにしっかりとすがる人は。 \q 安息日を守って、それを汚さず、 \q 決して手を出して悪を行わない。
ja.R: これを行い、しっかりと守る人は、なんと幸せなことか。 \q そういう人は、安息日を聖なる日として守り、ふつうの日のように扱わない。 \q どんな悪いこともしない。

uk.L: Блаженний смертний, [що] робить це, \q і {{gender:людина|син людський}}, [що] тримається цього, \q що береже суботу від збезчещення \q і береже свою руку від того, щоб чинити будь-яке зло.
uk.B: Який блаженний смертний, що робить це, \q людина, що тримається цього, \q що стереже суботу і не робить її буденною \q і не підніме руки, щоб чинити будь-яке зло.
uk.R: Люди, що роблять це і тримаються цього, будуть справді благословенні. \q Вони святять суботній день і не поводяться з ним, як зі звичайним днем. \q Вони не чинять нічого лихого.

decisions.choice: blessed: in a happy and favored state
decisions.reason: The word describes the good life of someone who lives in God's way (30:18; 32:20; Psalm 1:1).

decisions.choice: keeping the Sabbath from profaning it: resting on the seventh day and not treating it as an ordinary working day
decisions.reason: The Sabbath was the sign of the covenant between God and Israel (Exodus 31:13-17). To profane it was to use it like any other day, for work and trade (Jeremiah 17:21-27; Nehemiah 13:15-22).

decisions.choice: this ... it: what verse 1 commands, keeping justice and doing right
decisions.reason: The pronouns point back to the commands of verse 1; the rest of the verse names two examples, keeping the Sabbath and avoiding evil.

decisions.choice: human being (setting: son of man)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "son of man" means any human being, parallel to "mortal". Literal gives the inclusive form by default, with the word-for-word form as a reader setting.

decisions.choice: keep the Sabbath day holy and do not treat it like an ordinary day
decisions.reason: Readable explains what profaning the Sabbath means.

decisions.choice: el ser humano (setting: el hijo de hombre)
decisions.reason: "Son of man" here means any human being, parallel to "mortal"; Literal offers the gender setting as the English does.

decisions.choice: binadamu, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal sets "son of man" under the gender setting. Swahili "binadamu" is itself the ordinary word for a human being of either sex, so it stands at every level without a span; "mwana wa Adamu" is kept for the New Testament title.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:l'être humain|le fils d'homme}}"
decisions.reason: As the English, Literal gives the inclusive form by default; the traditional alternative is "le fils d'homme", not "le Fils de l'homme", which in French is the New Testament title.

decisions.choice: "con cái loài người" (son of man), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "human being

decisions.choice: "gender span 사람/사람의 아들" where the English Literal has a gender span for ben-'adam
decisions.reason: Korean has the two wordings the English setting offers: "사람", and the literal "사람의 아들"; the span keeps the reader's choice at Literal.

decisions.choice: Bem-aventurado (L); Como é feliz (B); Felizes de verdade (R)
decisions.reason: As the Psalms render 'ashre (Psalm 1:1): "bem-aventurado" at Literal, "Como é feliz" at Balanced and "feliz de verdade" at Readable. "Abençoado" says that someone has received a blessing, which is narrower than the happy, favored state meant here (m1).

decisions.choice: No gender span: "የሰው ልጅ" (L, B), "ሰዎች" (R)
decisions.reason: The English offers "human being" or "son of man" for ben-adam; Amharic "የሰው ልጅ" already means a human being of either sex, so the setting has nothing to change. It is the ordinary phrase here, not the title of Daniel 7 and the Gospels.

decisions.choice: gender span मानव / मनुष्य का पुत्र
decisions.reason: The English Literal gives the inclusive "human being" by default with "son of man" as the setting; Hindi does the same with मानव and मनुष्य का पुत्र. The phrase means any human being and is not Jesus' title.

decisions.choice: कितना धन्य है (L, B); का जीवन सचमुच अच्छा है (R)
decisions.reason: Ashrei has the Psalms wording at each level.

decisions.choice: {{gender:человек|сын человеческий}}
decisions.reason: "Son of man" here means any human being, parallel to "mortal"; Literal gives человек by default and the word-for-word сын человеческий as the setting's alternative, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Блажен (L, B); счастливы (R)
decisions.reason: Ashrei takes the poetry note's forms at each level.

decisions.choice: ben 'adam "人間" (L), "人" (B, R) with no gender span, where the English L has {{gender:human being|son of man}}: the Japanese is already inclusive, and "人の子" is the NT title, never used under the gender setting (style guide §6).
decisions.reason: No alternative is needed in Japanese.

decisions.choice: 'ashre "幸いだ" (L), "なんと幸いなことか" (B), "なんと幸せなことか" (R), as ISA-4 30:18, 32:20; shabbat "安息日" (every level); mechallelo "汚さず" (L, B), "ふつうの日のように扱わない" (R) (m2).
decisions.reason: The settled forms.

source.text: וְאַל־יֹאמַ֣ר בֶּן־הַנֵּכָ֗ר הַנִּלְוָ֤ה אֶל־יְהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַבְדֵּ֧ל יַבְדִּילַ֛נִי יְהוָ֖ה מֵעַ֣ל עַמּ֑וֹ וְאַל־יֹאמַר֙ הַסָּרִ֔יס הֵ֥ן אֲנִ֖י עֵ֥ץ יָבֵֽשׁ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And let not say the son of the foreignness who has joined himself to Yahweh, saying: surely he will separate me, Yahweh, from with his people; and let not say the eunuch: here! I [am] a tree dry.

en.L: And let not the foreigner who has joined himself to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} say, \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will surely separate me from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people"; \q and let not the eunuch say, \q "Look, I [am] a dry tree."
en.B: The foreigner who has attached himself to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} must not say, \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is sure to set me apart from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people." \q The eunuch must not say, \q "See, I am nothing but a dried-up tree."
en.R: Foreigners who have chosen to follow {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} should not say, \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will surely keep me away from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people." \q And a eunuch, a man who cannot father children, should not say, \q "I am like a dead tree that can never bear fruit."

es.L: Y no diga el extranjero que se ha unido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: \q «Ciertamente {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me apartará de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo»; \q y no diga el eunuco: \q «Mira, yo [soy] un árbol seco».
es.B: El extranjero que se ha unido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} no debe decir: \q «Sin duda {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me separará de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo». \q El eunuco no debe decir: \q «Mira, no soy más que un árbol seco».
es.R: Los extranjeros que han decidido seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} no deben decir: \q «Seguramente {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me mantendrá lejos de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo». \q Y un eunuco, un hombre que no puede tener hijos, no debe decir: \q «Soy como un árbol muerto que nunca podrá dar fruto».

fr.L: Et que l’étranger qui s’est attaché {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ne dise pas : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me séparera sûrement de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple » ; \q et que l’eunuque ne dise pas : \q « Voici, je [suis] un arbre sec. »
fr.B: L’étranger qui s’est attaché {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ne doit pas dire : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va certainement me mettre à l’écart de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. » \q L’eunuque ne doit pas dire : \q « Voyez, je ne suis qu’un arbre desséché. »
fr.R: Les étrangers qui ont choisi de suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne devraient pas dire : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va sûrement me tenir à l’écart de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. » \q Et un eunuque, un homme qui ne peut pas avoir d’enfants, ne devrait pas dire : \q « Je suis comme un arbre mort qui ne pourra jamais porter de fruit. »

sw.L: Na mgeni aliyejiunga na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asiseme, \q "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakika atanitenga na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}"; \q wala towashi asiseme, \q "Tazama, mimi [ni] mti mkavu."
sw.B: Mgeni aliyejiambatanisha na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asiseme, \q "Hakika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atanitenga na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}." \q Towashi asiseme, \q "Tazama, mimi si kitu ila mti uliokauka."
sw.R: Wageni ambao wameamua kumfuata {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wasiseme, \q "Hakika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataniweka mbali na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}." \q Na towashi, yaani mwanamume asiyeweza kuzaa watoto, asiseme, \q "Mimi ni kama mti uliokufa ambao hauwezi kuzaa matunda kamwe."

vi.L: Và người ngoại bang đã gắn bó với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chớ nói: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chắc sẽ tách tôi khỏi dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}"; \q và người hoạn quan chớ nói: \q "Kìa, tôi [là] cây khô."
vi.B: Người ngoại quốc đã theo về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đừng nói: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hẳn sẽ tách riêng tôi ra khỏi dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}." \q Người hoạn quan đừng nói: \q "Này, tôi chỉ là một cây khô."
vi.R: Những người ngoại quốc đã chọn theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không nên nói: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chắc chắn sẽ không cho tôi ở giữa dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}." \q Còn người hoạn quan, là người đàn ông không thể có con, không nên nói: \q "Tôi giống như một cây chết, chẳng bao giờ có thể sinh trái."

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 연합한 이방 사람은 \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 반드시 나를 그분의 백성에게서 갈라놓으실 것이다" 하고 말하지 말아야 하고, \q 내시도 \q "보라, 나는 마른 나무다" 하고 말하지 말아야 한다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따르기로 한 이방 사람은 \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 틀림없이 나를 그분의 백성에게서 떼어 놓으실 것이다" 하고 말하지 마라. \q 내시도 \q "보아라, 나는 말라 버린 나무일 뿐이다" 하고 말하지 마라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따르기로 한 외국 사람들은 \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 분명히 나를 그분의 백성에게서 떼어 놓으실 거야" 하고 말하지 말아야 한다. \q 자녀를 낳을 수 없는 남자인 내시도 \q "나는 열매를 맺지 못하는 죽은 나무와 같다" 하고 말하지 말아야 한다.

pt.L: E não diga o estrangeiro que se uniu {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: \q "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} certamente me separará do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo"; \q e não diga o eunuco: \q "Ora, eu [sou] uma árvore seca."
pt.B: O estrangeiro que se juntou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} não deve dizer: \q "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} com certeza vai me excluir do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo." \q O eunuco não deve dizer: \q "Vejam, não passo de uma árvore seca."
pt.R: Os estrangeiros que escolheram seguir {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não devem dizer: \q "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} com certeza vai me deixar longe do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo." \q E o eunuco, um homem que não pode ter filhos, não deve dizer: \q "Sou como uma árvore morta que nunca vai dar fruto."

am.L: {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ጋር የተጣበቀ የባዕድ ልጅ፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሕዝቡ ፈጽሞ ይለየኛል» አይበል፤ \q ጃንደረባውም፦ \q «እነሆ፣ እኔ ደረቅ ዛፍ [ነኝ]» አይበል።
am.B: {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ጋር የተባበረ ባዕድ፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሕዝቡ መለየቱ አይቀርም» አይበል። \q ጃንደረባውም፦ \q «ተመልከቱ፣ እኔ የደረቀ ዛፍ ብቻ ነኝ» አይበል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለመከተል የመረጡ ባዕዳን፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሕዝቡ ፈጽሞ ያርቀኛል» ማለት የለባቸውም። \q ልጅ መውለድ የማይችል ሰው የሆነ ጃንደረባም፦ \q «ፍሬ ፈጽሞ ማፍራት እንደማይችል የሞተ ዛፍ ነኝ» ማለት የለበትም።

hi.L: और जो विदेशी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से जुड़ गया है, वह यह न कहे, \q "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मुझे निश्चय अपनी प्रजा से अलग कर देंगे"; \q और खोजा यह न कहे, \q "देखो, मैं सूखा पेड़ [हूँ]।"
hi.B: जो विदेशी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से जुड़ गया है, वह यह न कहे, \q "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मुझे अपनी प्रजा से ज़रूर अलग कर देंगे।" \q खोजा यह न कहे, \q "देखो, मैं तो बस एक सूखा हुआ पेड़ हूँ।"
hi.R: जिन विदेशियों ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पीछे चलने का निर्णय किया है, वे यह न कहें, \q "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मुझे अपनी प्रजा से ज़रूर दूर रखेंगे।" \q और कोई खोजा, यानी ऐसा पुरुष जो सन्तान उत्पन्न नहीं कर सकता, यह न कहे, \q "मैं उस सूखे पेड़ जैसा हूँ जिसमें कभी फल नहीं लगेगा।"

ru.L: И пусть не говорит чужеземец, присоединившийся к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}: \q «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} непременно отделит меня от своего народа»; \q и пусть не говорит евнух: \q «Вот, я — сухое дерево.»
ru.B: Чужеземец, который присоединился к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, не должен говорить: \q «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} обязательно отлучит меня от своего народа.» \q Евнух не должен говорить: \q «Смотрите, я всего лишь засохшее дерево.»
ru.R: Чужеземцы, которые решили следовать за {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, не должны говорить: \q «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} непременно отстранит меня от своего народа.» \q И евнух, человек, который не может иметь детей, не должен говорить: \q «Я как мёртвое дерево, которое никогда не принесёт плода.»

ja.L: また、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に結びついた異国の人は、言うな。 \q 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は必ずわたしを、ご自分の民から引き離される」と。 \q また、宦官は言うな。 \q 「このとおり、わたしは枯れた木だ」と。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に連なった外国の人は、 \q 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はきっと、わたしをご自分の民から引き離される」と言ってはならない。 \q 宦官も、 \q 「わたしは干からびた木にすぎない」と言ってはならない。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に従うことを選んだ外国人は、 \q 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、きっとわたしを、ご自分の民から遠ざけられる」と言ってはいけない。 \q また、子どもをもつことのできない男の人も、 \q 「わたしは、決して実を結ばない枯れた木のようだ」と言ってはいけない。

uk.L: І нехай не каже чужинець, що приєднався до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}: \q «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} неодмінно відлучить мене від свого народу»; \q і нехай не каже євнух: \q «Ось я — суходрев.»
uk.B: Чужинець, що пристав до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, не повинен казати: \q «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} напевно відлучить мене від свого народу.» \q Євнух не повинен казати: \q «Дивіться, я лише висохле дерево.»
uk.R: Чужинці, які вирішили йти за {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, не повинні казати: \q «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} напевно не допустить мене до свого народу.» \q І євнух, чоловік, що не може мати дітей, не повинен казати: \q «Я — як мертве дерево, що ніколи не принесе плоду.»

decisions.choice: the foreigner, the eunuch: two kinds of people the law kept out of the assembly of the LORD
decisions.reason: A eunuch is a castrated man, often an official at a royal court (39:7; 2 Kings 20:18). The law excluded such a man from the assembly of the LORD, and also excluded certain foreign peoples (Deuteronomy 23:2-9, which is 23:1-8 in many translations). The promise that follows overturns their fear.

decisions.choice: joined himself to the LORD: bound himself to the LORD by his own choice
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of foreigners joining Israel in 14:1 and of nations joining themselves to the LORD in Zechariah 2:15 (2:11 in many translations).

decisions.choice: a dry tree: a man with no children to carry on his name
decisions.reason: A tree that is dry bears no fruit. The eunuch fears that, with no descendants, his name will die with him. Verse 5 answers that fear.

decisions.choice: a eunuch, a man who cannot father children; a dead tree that can never bear fruit
decisions.reason: Readable explains what a eunuch is and what the picture of a dry tree means.

decisions.choice: eunuco
decisions.reason: Here the point is the man's inability to have children, so Spanish keeps "eunuco" at every level, and Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "hoạn quan" (eunuch)
decisions.reason: "Hoạn quan" is the word used for the Ethiopian official in Acts 8:27; "thái giám" belongs to the Chinese and Vietnamese royal courts. Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ጃንደረባ" at every level
decisions.reason: In Kings saris is "ጃንደረባ" (L) and "ሹም" (B, R) where it names a court official; here the point is that the man cannot father children (the dry tree), so "ጃንደረባ" stays at every level and Readable explains it, as its English.

decisions.choice: विदेशी; खोजा
decisions.reason: The foreigner (ben hannekar) is विदेशी, kept apart from the resident alien (ger, परदेशी), as the Ezra forms have it; the eunuch is खोजा, the word of Acts 8:27 and Isaiah 39:7.

decisions.choice: ben hannekhar "異国の人" (L), "外国の人" (B), "外国人" (R), as bene nekhar in the OT notes (異国の子ら L, 外国の人々 B, R; LEV 22:25 外国人); saris "宦官" (L, B), "子どもをもつことのできない男の人" (R; 宦 is not Jōyō), as 2KI 20:18 and the EST notes.
decisions.reason: The settled words; Readable explains the eunuch as its English does.

decisions.choice: The foreigner speaks of the LORD with respect forms ("引き離される", "遠ざけられる"); hen in the eunuch's mouth "このとおり" (L) as 49:21, not "見なさい"; the negative jussives "言うな" (L), "言ってはならない" (B), "言ってはいけない" (R).
decisions.reason: Human speakers keep respect forms for God.

source.text: כִּי־כֹ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לַסָּֽרִיסִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁמְרוּ֙ אֶת־שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֔י וּבָֽחֲר֖וּ בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר חָפָ֑צְתִּי וּמַחֲזִיקִ֖ים בִּבְרִיתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh to the eunuchs who keep my sabbaths and choose [that] in which I delight and [are] holding fast to my covenant:

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to the eunuchs who keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbaths, \q and choose [that] in which I delight, \q and hold fast to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant:
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this to the eunuchs who keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbaths, \q who choose what gives {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pleasure, \q and who hold firmly to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant:
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says to eunuchs who keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbath days, \q who choose to do what I want, \q and who are faithful to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant:

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a los eunucos que guardan {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados, \q y escogen [lo] que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agrada, \q y se aferran a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto:
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto a los eunucos que guardan {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados, \q que escogen lo que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} complace \q y se mantienen firmes en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto:
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a los eunucos que guardan {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} días de sábado, \q que deciden hacer lo que yo quiero \q y que son fieles a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto:

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aux eunuques qui gardent {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sabbats, \q et qui choisissent ce qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} plaît, \q et qui tiennent ferme {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance :
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci aux eunuques qui gardent {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sabbats, \q qui choisissent ce qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} fait plaisir \q et qui s’attachent fermement à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance :
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aux eunuques qui respectent {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jours de sabbat, \q qui choisissent de faire ce que je veux \q et qui sont fidèles à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance :

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi kwa matowashi wanaozishika Sabato {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, \q na kuchagua [yale] ninayoyapenda, \q na kulishika sana agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}:
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo kwa matowashi wanaozishika Sabato {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, \q wanaochagua yale yanayonipendeza, \q na wanaolishikilia imara agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}:
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema kwa matowashi wanaozishika siku {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} za Sabato, \q wanaochagua kufanya ninayotaka, \q na walio waaminifu kwa agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}:

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này với những hoạn quan giữ các ngày Sa-bát của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và chọn [điều] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vui thích, \q và giữ chặt giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}:
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy với những hoạn quan giữ các ngày Sa-bát của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q chọn điều đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và giữ vững giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}:
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với những hoạn quan giữ các ngày Sa-bát của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q chọn làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn, \q và trung tín với giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}:

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나의 안식일들을 지키고, \q 내가 기뻐하는 것을 택하며, \q 나의 언약을 굳게 붙잡는 내시들에게 이와 같이 말씀하신다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 안식일들을 지키고, \q 내가 기뻐하는 것을 택하며, \q 내 언약을 굳게 붙드는 내시들에게 이렇게 말씀하신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 안식일을 지키고, \q 내가 원하는 일을 하기로 하며, \q 내 언약에 신실한 내시들에게 하시는 말씀이다.

pt.L: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} aos eunucos que guardam os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} sábados, \q e escolhem [aquilo] em que tenho prazer, \q e se apegam à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança:
pt.B: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} aos eunucos que guardam os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} sábados, \q que escolhem o que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agrada \q e se mantêm firmes na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança:
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz aos eunucos que guardam os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} sábados, \q que escolhem fazer o que eu quero \q e que são fiéis à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança:

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላልና፤ ሰንበቶቼን ለሚጠብቁ ጃንደረቦች፣ \q ደስ የሚያሰኘኝንም ለሚመርጡ፣ \q ቃል ኪዳኔንም አጥብቀው ለሚይዙ፦
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሰንበቶቼን ለሚጠብቁ ጃንደረቦች እንዲህ ይላልና፤ \q ደስ የሚያሰኘኝን ለሚመርጡ፣ \q ቃል ኪዳኔንም አጽንተው ለሚይዙ፦
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሰንበት ቀኖቼን ለሚጠብቁ ጃንደረቦች እንዲህ ይላል፤ \q እኔ የምፈልገውን ለማድረግ ለሚመርጡ፣ \q ለቃል ኪዳኔም ታማኝ ለሆኑ፦

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उन खोजों से यों कहते हैं जो मेरे सब्तों को मानते हैं, \q और उसे चुनते हैं [जिससे] मैं प्रसन्न होता हूँ, \q और मेरी वाचा को दृढ़ता से थामे रहते हैं:
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उन खोजों से यह कहते हैं जो मेरे सब्तों का पालन करते हैं, \q जो वह चुनते हैं जो मुझे भाता है, \q और जो मेरी वाचा को मज़बूती से पकड़े रहते हैं:
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उन खोजों से यह कहते हैं जो मेरे सब्त के दिनों को मानते हैं, \q जो वही करना चुनते हैं जो मैं चाहता हूँ, \q और जो मेरी वाचा के प्रति विश्वासयोग्य रहते हैं:

ru.L: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} евнухам, которые соблюдают {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} субботы, \q и избирают [то], в чём {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} нахожу радость, \q и крепко держатся {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} завета:
ru.B: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} евнухам, которые хранят {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} субботы, \q которые избирают то, что {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} приятно, \q и твёрдо держатся {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} завета:
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} евнухам, которые соблюдают {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} субботы, \q которые решают делать то, чего {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хочу, \q и которые верны {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} завету:

ja.L: まことに、わたしの安息日を守り、 \q わたしの喜ぶことを選び、 \q わたしの契約を堅く守る宦官たちに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。
ja.B: わたしの安息日を守り、 \q わたしの喜ぶことを選び、 \q わたしの契約にしっかりとすがる宦官たちに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、こう言われる。
ja.R: わたしの安息日を守り、 \q わたしが望むことを選んで行い、 \q わたしの契約に忠実な、子どもをもつことのできない男の人たちに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。

uk.L: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} євнухам, що бережуть {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} суботи \q і вибирають [те], чого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} бажаю, \q і тримаються {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} завіту:
uk.B: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} говорить так євнухам, що бережуть {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} суботи, \q що вибирають те, що {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}} до вподоби, \q і що міцно тримаються {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} завіту:
uk.R: Ось що каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} євнухам, які дотримують {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} суботніх днів, \q які вирішують робити те, чого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хочу, \q і які вірні {{deity_pronoun:моєму|Моєму}} завітові:

decisions.choice: my covenant: the covenant God made with Israel
decisions.reason: Holding fast to the covenant means keeping faith with the LORD and his commands. The Sabbath is called a lasting covenant in Exodus 31:16, so keeping it is a mark of belonging.

decisions.choice: my Sabbaths: the plural takes in every Sabbath
decisions.reason: The plural may mean each weekly Sabbath, as in Exodus 31:13, or include the other days of rest in Israel's calendar (Leviticus 23).

decisions.choice: The relative clauses on the eunuchs come before "主はこう言われる", which closes the verse at every level (ISA-6 42:5, 45:18): Japanese puts the modifier before its noun.
decisions.reason: The verb of saying goes last; the content stays in the verse.

records.literal_gloss: and I will give to them in my house and in my walls a monument and a name better than sons and than daughters; a name of perpetuity I will give to him, which will not be cut off.

en.L: I will give to them in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house and within {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} walls a monument and a name better than sons and daughters; \q an everlasting name I will give to him, \q which will not be cut off.
en.B: within {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house and inside {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} walls I will set up for them a monument and a name worth more than sons and daughters. \q I will give each of them a name that lasts forever, \q one that will never be wiped out.
en.R: I will give them a place in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house, inside {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} walls. They will be remembered there. \q That will be better than having sons and daughters to carry on their name. \q I will give them a name that will last forever. \q It will never be forgotten.

es.L: Les daré en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa y dentro de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} muros un monumento y un nombre mejor que [el de] hijos e hijas; \q un nombre eterno le daré, \q que no será cortado.
es.B: dentro de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa y en el interior de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} muros les levantaré un monumento y un nombre que vale más que hijos e hijas. \q A cada uno le daré un nombre que dure para siempre, \q que nunca será borrado.
es.R: Les daré un lugar en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa, dentro de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} muros. Allí serán recordados. \q Eso será mejor que tener hijos e hijas que lleven su nombre. \q Les daré un nombre que durará para siempre. \q Nunca será olvidado.

fr.L: Je leur donnerai dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison et dans {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} murs un monument et un nom meilleurs que des fils et des filles ; \q un nom éternel je lui donnerai, \q qui ne sera pas retranché.
fr.B: dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison et à l’intérieur de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} murs, je leur élèverai un monument et un nom qui vaudront mieux que des fils et des filles. \q Je donnerai à chacun d’eux un nom qui durera toujours, \q un nom qui ne sera jamais effacé.
fr.R: Je leur donnerai une place dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison, à l’intérieur de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} murs. On se souviendra d’eux là-bas. \q Ce sera mieux que d’avoir des fils et des filles pour garder leur nom. \q Je leur donnerai un nom qui durera toujours. \q On ne l’oubliera jamais.

sw.L: Nitawapa katika nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na ndani ya kuta {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} ukumbusho na jina lililo bora kuliko wana na binti; \q nitampa jina la milele, \q ambalo halitakatiliwa mbali.
sw.B: ndani ya nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na ndani ya kuta {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} nitawasimamishia ukumbusho na jina lenye thamani kuliko wana na binti. \q Nitampa kila mmoja wao jina litakalodumu milele, \q ambalo halitafutwa kamwe.
sw.R: Nitawapa mahali katika nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ndani ya kuta {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}. Watakumbukwa huko. \q Hilo litakuwa bora kuliko kuwa na wana na binti wa kuendeleza jina lao. \q Nitawapa jina litakalodumu milele. \q Halitasahaulika kamwe.

vi.L: Ta sẽ ban cho họ trong nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và trong tường thành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một đài kỷ niệm và một danh tốt hơn con trai và con gái; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho người một danh đời đời, \q là danh sẽ không bị diệt trừ.
vi.B: trong nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và bên trong tường thành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dựng cho họ một đài tưởng niệm và một danh quý hơn có con trai con gái. \q Ta sẽ ban cho mỗi người họ một danh còn đến đời đời, \q một danh sẽ không bao giờ bị xóa bỏ.
vi.R: Ta sẽ ban cho họ một chỗ trong nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, bên trong tường thành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Người ta sẽ nhớ đến họ ở đó. \q Điều đó còn tốt hơn là có con trai con gái để nối dõi tên tuổi. \q Ta sẽ ban cho họ một danh còn mãi mãi. \q Danh ấy sẽ không bao giờ bị quên lãng.

ko.L: 내가 나의 집과 나의 성벽 안에 그들에게 아들들과 딸들보다 나은 기념비와 이름을 주겠다. \q 내가 그에게 영원한 이름을 주겠으니, \q 그것이 끊어지지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 나는 내 집 안에, 내 성벽 안에 그들을 위해 아들딸보다 더 나은 기념비와 이름을 세워 주겠다. \q 내가 그들 하나하나에게 영원히 남을 이름을 주겠다. \q 그 이름은 결코 지워지지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 내 집 안에, 내 성벽 안에 그들의 자리를 주겠다. 그들은 그곳에서 기억될 것이다. \q 그것은 그들의 이름을 이어 갈 아들딸을 두는 것보다 더 나을 것이다. \q 내가 그들에게 영원히 남을 이름을 주겠다. \q 그 이름은 결코 잊히지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Eu lhes darei na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} casa e dentro dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} muros um memorial e um nome melhor do que filhos e filhas; \q um nome eterno darei a ele, \q que não será eliminado.
pt.B: dentro da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} casa e dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} muros eu lhes darei um memorial e um nome que valem mais do que filhos e filhas. \q Darei a cada um deles um nome que dura para sempre, \q um nome que nunca será apagado.
pt.R: Eu vou dar a eles um lugar na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} casa, dentro dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} muros. Ali eles serão lembrados. \q Isso vai ser melhor do que ter filhos e filhas para manter vivo o nome deles. \q Vou dar a eles um nome que vai durar para sempre. \q Ele nunca vai ser esquecido.

am.L: በቤቴና በቅጥሮቼ ውስጥ ከወንዶችና ከሴቶች ልጆች የሚሻል መታሰቢያና ስም እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ \q የዘላለም ስም እሰጠዋለሁ፤ \q የማይቆረጥም [ስም]።
am.B: በቤቴና በቅጥሮቼ ውስጥ ከወንዶችና ከሴቶች ልጆች የሚበልጥ መታሰቢያና ስም አቆምላቸዋለሁ። \q ለእያንዳንዳቸው ለዘላለም የሚኖር ስም እሰጣለሁ፤ \q ፈጽሞ የማይደመሰስ ስም።
am.R: በቤቴ፣ በቅጥሮቼ ውስጥ ስፍራ እሰጣቸዋለሁ። በዚያም ይታወሳሉ። \q ይህም ስማቸውን የሚያስጠሩ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆች ከማግኘት ይበልጣል። \q ለዘላለም የሚኖር ስም እሰጣቸዋለሁ። \q ፈጽሞ አይረሳም።

hi.L: मैं उन्हें अपने भवन में और अपनी शहरपनाह के भीतर पुत्रों और पुत्रियों से उत्तम एक स्मारक और एक नाम दूँगा; \q मैं उसे सदा का नाम दूँगा, \q जो न मिटेगा।
hi.B: अपने भवन में और अपनी शहरपनाह के भीतर मैं उनके लिए एक स्मारक और एक नाम स्थापित करूँगा जो पुत्रों और पुत्रियों से भी बढ़कर है। \q मैं उनमें से हर एक को ऐसा नाम दूँगा जो सदा बना रहेगा, \q ऐसा नाम जो कभी नहीं मिटेगा।
hi.R: मैं उन्हें अपने भवन में, अपनी शहरपनाह के भीतर, एक स्थान दूँगा। वहाँ उन्हें याद रखा जाएगा। \q यह उनके लिए अपना नाम आगे बढ़ानेवाले बेटे-बेटियाँ होने से भी अच्छा होगा। \q मैं उन्हें ऐसा नाम दूँगा जो सदा बना रहेगा। \q वह कभी भुलाया नहीं जाएगा।

ru.L: Я дам им в {{deity_pronoun:моём|Моём}} доме и в {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} стенах памятник и имя лучше сыновей и дочерей; \q вечное имя {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам ему, \q которое не истребится.
ru.B: в {{deity_pronoun:моём|Моём}} доме и в {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} стенах {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поставлю им памятник и имя, которые дороже сыновей и дочерей. \q Я дам каждому из них имя, которое будет вечным, \q имя, которое никогда не будет стёрто.
ru.R: Я дам им место в {{deity_pronoun:моём|Моём}} доме, в {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} стенах. Там их будут помнить. \q Это будет лучше, чем иметь сыновей и дочерей, которые продолжили бы их имя. \q Я дам им имя, которое будет жить вечно. \q Оно никогда не будет забыто.

ja.L: わたしは彼らに、わたしの家に、わたしの城壁の内に、息子や娘にまさる記念の碑と名を与える。 \q わたしは彼に永遠の名を与える。 \q それは断たれることがない。
ja.B: わたしの家の中、わたしの城壁の内に、わたしは彼らのために、息子や娘よりもまさる記念の碑と名を立てる。 \q わたしは一人一人に、とこしえに続く名を与える。 \q それは決して消し去られることがない。
ja.R: わたしは、わたしの家の中、わたしの城壁の内に、彼らの場所を与える。彼らはそこで覚えられる。 \q それは、名を残す息子や娘をもつことよりも、すばらしい。 \q わたしは彼らに、いつまでも続く名を与える。 \q その名は、決して忘れられない。

uk.L: Я дам їм у {{deity_pronoun:моєму|Моєму}} домі і в {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} мурах памʼятник і імʼя, краще від синів і дочок; \q вічне імʼя {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам йому, \q що не буде винищене.
uk.B: у {{deity_pronoun:моєму|Моєму}} домі і в {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} мурах {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поставлю їм памʼятник та імʼя, цінніше від синів і дочок. \q Я дам кожному з них імʼя, що триває вічно, \q імʼя, що ніколи не буде стерте.
uk.R: Я дам їм місце в {{deity_pronoun:моєму|Моєму}} домі, у {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} мурах. Там їх памʼятатимуть. \q Це буде краще, ніж мати синів і дочок, що продовжили б їхнє імʼя. \q Я дам їм імʼя, що триватиме вічно. \q Його ніколи не забудуть.

decisions.choice: a monument and a name: a lasting memorial, so that a person is not forgotten
decisions.reason: The word for monument is literally "hand". Absalom, who had no son, set up a pillar called his "hand" so that his name would be remembered (2 Samuel 18:18). Israel's memorial to the victims of the Holocaust, Yad Vashem, takes its name from this verse.

decisions.choice: my house and my walls: the temple and its courts
decisions.reason: The eunuch who might have been kept out of the assembly is given a place of honor inside God's own house (verse 7).

decisions.choice: to him: to each one of them
decisions.reason: The pronoun changes from plural to singular: each faithful eunuch receives his own lasting name.

decisions.choice: each of them
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the meaning decision on the singular pronoun; Literal keeps "him".

decisions.choice: They will be remembered there; to carry on their name
decisions.reason: Readable explains that the monument and name keep a person's memory alive, as children would.

decisions.choice: памятник и имя
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "hand" here is a monument, a lasting memorial (m1); Literal says памятник, as the English does, with "name" beside it.

decisions.choice: yad vashem "記念の碑と名" (L, B): a lasting memorial (m1); lo "彼に" (L), "一人一人に" (B), "彼らに" (R): to each of them (m3); shem 'olam "永遠の名" (L), "とこしえに続く名" (B).
decisions.reason: The singular of the Hebrew kept at L, made distributive at B.

decisions.choice: "памʼятник і імʼя" for a monument and a name
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is "hand", used for a memorial stone; the meaning decision gives the sense, which the English Literal also writes as "monument".

source.text: וּבְנֵ֣י הַנֵּכָ֗ר הַנִּלְוִ֤ים עַל־יְהוָה֙ לְשָׁ֣רְת֔וֹ וּֽלְאַהֲבָה֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה לִהְי֥וֹת ל֖וֹ לַעֲבָדִ֑ים כָּל־שֹׁמֵ֤ר שַׁבָּת֙ מֵֽחַלְּל֔וֹ וּמַחֲזִיקִ֖ים בִּבְרִיתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And the sons of the foreignness who join themselves to Yahweh, to serve him and to love the name of Yahweh, to become his for servants, every [one who] keeps [the] sabbath from profaning it and [who are] holding fast to my covenant,

en.L: And the foreigners who join themselves to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and to love the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants, \q everyone who keeps [the] Sabbath from profaning it \q and holds fast to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant,
en.B: As for the foreigners who attach themselves to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q who love the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and become {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants, \q everyone who guards the Sabbath and does not make it common \q and who clings to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant,
en.R: Foreigners may also join themselves to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q They serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, love the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and become {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants. \q They keep the Sabbath day holy and do not treat it like an ordinary day. \q They are faithful to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant.

es.L: Y a los extranjeros que se unen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} para servir a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q y para amar el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q para ser {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos, \q a todo el que guarda el sábado para no profanarlo \q y se aferra a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto,
es.B: En cuanto a los extranjeros que se unen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirven, \q que aman el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y se hacen {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos, \q a todo el que guarda el sábado y no lo trata como algo común \q y se mantiene firme en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto,
es.R: Los extranjeros también pueden unirse {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. \q Le sirven, aman el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y se hacen {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos. \q Guardan el día de sábado como día santo y no lo tratan como un día cualquiera. \q Son fieles a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto.

fr.L: Et les étrangers qui s’attachent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir, \q et pour aimer le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q pour être {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs, \q quiconque garde le sabbat sans le profaner \q et tient ferme {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance,
fr.B: Quant aux étrangers qui s’attachent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servent, \q qui aiment le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et deviennent {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs, \q tous ceux qui gardent le sabbat sans le traiter comme un jour ordinaire \q et qui s’attachent à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance,
fr.R: Des étrangers peuvent aussi s’attacher {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. \q Ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servent, ils aiment le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ils deviennent {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs. \q Ils respectent le sabbat comme un jour saint et ne le traitent pas comme un jour ordinaire. \q Ils sont fidèles à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance.

sw.L: Na wageni wanaojiunga na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili kumtumikia, \q na kulipenda jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ili kuwa watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q kila mmoja anayeishika Sabato asiitie unajisi \q na kulishika sana agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}},
sw.B: Na kuhusu wageni wanaojiambatanisha na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wanaomtumikia, \q wanaolipenda jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuwa watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q kila mmoja anayeilinda Sabato asiifanye kuwa siku ya kawaida \q na anayelishikilia agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}},
sw.R: Wageni nao wanaweza kujiunga na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Wanamtumikia, wanalipenda jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kuwa watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Wanaiweka siku ya Sabato kuwa takatifu wala hawaitendei kama siku ya kawaida. \q Wao ni waaminifu kwa agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.

vi.L: Và những người ngoại bang gắn bó với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và để yêu mến danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q để làm đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q mọi người giữ ngày Sa-bát, không làm ô uế nó, \q và giữ chặt giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.B: Còn những người ngoại quốc theo về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q yêu mến danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trở nên đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q mọi người giữ ngày Sa-bát, không coi nó như ngày thường, \q và bám chặt giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.R: Những người ngoại quốc cũng có thể theo về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Họ phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, yêu mến danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và trở thành đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Họ giữ ngày Sa-bát thánh khiết và không coi nó như một ngày bình thường. \q Họ trung tín với giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 연합하여 그를 섬기고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 사랑하며, \q 그의 종들이 되려는 이방 사람들, \q 곧 안식일을 지켜 더럽히지 않고 \q 나의 언약을 굳게 붙잡는 모든 자를
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따르며 그를 섬기고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 사랑하여 그의 종이 된 이방 사람들, \q 안식일을 지켜 그날을 속되게 하지 않고 \q 내 언약을 굳게 붙드는 사람은 누구든지,
ko.R: 외국 사람들도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따를 수 있다. \q 그들은 그를 섬기고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 사랑하며, 그의 종이 된다. \q 그들은 안식일을 거룩하게 지키고, 그날을 보통 날처럼 여기지 않는다. \q 그들은 내 언약에 신실하다.

pt.L: E os estrangeiros que se unem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, para {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} servir, \q e para amar o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q para serem {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos, \q todo aquele que guarda [o] sábado para não o profanar \q e se apega à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança,
pt.B: Quanto aos estrangeiros que se juntam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} servem, \q que amam o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e se tornam {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos, \q todo aquele que guarda o sábado e não o trata como dia comum \q e que se mantém firme na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança,
pt.R: Estrangeiros também podem se unir {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. \q Eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} servem, amam o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e se tornam {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos. \q Eles guardam o sábado como dia santo e não o tratam como um dia qualquer. \q Eles são fiéis à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança.

am.L: {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ጋር የሚተባበሩ የባዕድ ልጆች፣ እርሱን ያገለግሉ ዘንድ፣ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም ይወዱ ዘንድ፣ \q ባሪያዎቹ ይሆኑ ዘንድ፣ \q ሰንበትን ከማቃለል የሚጠብቅ ሁሉ፣ \q ቃል ኪዳኔንም አጥብቆ የሚይዝ፣
am.B: {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ጋር የሚተባበሩ ባዕዳን፣ እርሱን የሚያገለግሉ፣ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም የሚወዱና አገልጋዮቹ የሚሆኑ፣ \q ሰንበትን ሳያቃልሉ የሚጠብቁ ሁሉ፣ \q ቃል ኪዳኔንም አጥብቀው የሚይዙ፣
am.R: ባዕዳንም {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ጋር ሊተባበሩ ይችላሉ። \q እርሱን ያገለግላሉ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም ይወዳሉ፤ አገልጋዮቹም ይሆናሉ። \q የሰንበትን ቀን ይቀድሳሉ፤ እንደ ተራ ቀንም አይቆጥሩትም። \q ለቃል ኪዳኔ ታማኞች ናቸው።

hi.L: और जो विदेशी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से जुड़ जाते हैं, कि उनकी सेवा करें, \q और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से प्रेम करें, \q कि उनके दास बनें, \q हर एक जो सब्त को अपवित्र करने से बचाए रखता है \q और मेरी वाचा को दृढ़ता से थामे रहता है,
hi.B: और वे विदेशी जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से जुड़ जाते हैं, जो उनकी सेवा करते हैं, \q जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से प्रेम करते हैं और उनके दास बन जाते हैं, \q हर एक जो सब्त की रक्षा करता है और उसे साधारण दिन नहीं बनाता \q और जो मेरी वाचा से लिपटा रहता है,
hi.R: विदेशी भी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से जुड़ सकते हैं। \q वे उनकी सेवा करते हैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से प्रेम करते हैं, और उनके दास बन जाते हैं। \q वे सब्त के दिन को पवित्र रखते हैं और उसे साधारण दिन की तरह नहीं मानते। \q वे मेरी वाचा के प्रति विश्वासयोग्य रहते हैं।

ru.L: И чужеземцев, присоединившихся к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, чтобы служить {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} \q и любить имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q чтобы быть {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} рабами, \q всякого, кто соблюдает субботу, чтобы не осквернить её, \q и крепко держится {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} завета,
ru.B: А чужеземцев, которые присоединяются к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, которые служат {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}, \q которые любят имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и становятся {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} рабами, \q всякого, кто хранит субботу и не делает её обычным днём \q и кто твёрдо держится {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} завета,
ru.R: Чужеземцы тоже могут присоединиться к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. \q Они служат {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}, любят имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и становятся {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} рабами. \q Они хранят субботу святой и не обращаются с ней как с обычным днём. \q Они верны {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} завету.

ja.L: また、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に結びつき、仕え、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を愛し、 \q そのしもべとなる異国の子らを、 \q 安息日を守ってこれを汚さず、 \q わたしの契約を堅く守る者を皆、
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に連なり、仕える外国の人々、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を愛し、そのしもべとなる者たち、 \q 安息日を守って汚さない者、 \q わたしの契約にしっかりとすがる者を皆、
ja.R: 外国人も、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に連なることができる。 \q 彼らは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を愛して仕え、そのしもべとなる。 \q 彼らは安息日を聖なる日として守り、ふつうの日のように扱わない。 \q わたしの契約に忠実である。

uk.L: І чужинців, що приєднуються до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, щоб служити {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} \q і любити імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q щоб бути {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слугами, \q кожного, хто береже суботу від збезчещення \q і тримається {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} завіту,
uk.B: А чужинців, що пристають до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, що служать {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, \q що люблять імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і стають {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слугами, \q кожного, хто стереже суботу і не робить її буденною \q і хто тримається {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} завіту,
uk.R: Чужинці теж можуть приєднатися до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. \q Вони служать {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, люблять імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і стають {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слугами. \q Вони святять суботній день і не поводяться з ним, як зі звичайним днем. \q Вони вірні {{deity_pronoun:моєму|Моєму}} завітові.

decisions.choice: the sons of foreignness: foreigners, people of other nations
decisions.reason: "Son of" with a noun names a person of that kind. The same phrase is in verse 3.

decisions.choice: to serve him: to minister to him in worship
decisions.reason: The verb is often used of the service of priests and Levites (61:6; Deuteronomy 10:8). Here it may mean worship in general, or service at the temple itself (66:21).

decisions.choice: to be his servants: foreigners take the place Israel is given in these chapters
decisions.reason: Through chapters 40-55 Israel is the LORD's servant (41:8; 44:1). Here foreigners who love his name share that title.

decisions.choice: servos
decisions.reason: Foreigners here receive the title that chapters 40-55 give to Israel and to the one servant (m3), so Literal keeps "servos", as at 49:3 and 54:17, rather than the Old Testament's Literal "escravos".

decisions.choice: उनके दास
decisions.reason: Foreigners who love his name become the LORD's servants (दास), the title Israel bears in chapters 40-55, so the same word is used.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} рабами
decisions.reason: Foreigners take the place given to Israel, the LORD's servant, in these chapters (m3), so the word is раб, as for the servant and for the servants of 54:17.

decisions.choice: la'avadim "そのしもべ" (every level), the plural servants of 54:17 (ISA-6: しもべ at every level); the foreigners take Israel's place as servants (m3). God is the speaker, so "him / his" are left out or "その" (no "その方" for God himself, no respect forms).
decisions.reason: God speaks of himself in the third person plainly (ISA-6).

decisions.choice: The foreigners are the object of "I will bring them" in 56:7, so 56:6 ends with "……を皆、" (L, B) and the verb comes in 56:7.
decisions.reason: Japanese keeps the object in its own verse and the verb in the next.
